title: The Good Dinosaur
desc: A rainstorm separates Arlo, a young Apatosaurus, from his family. While traveling through a harsh landscape, he befriends Spot, a feral human kid, who helps him reunite with his family.

title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
desc: When New York is put under siege by Oscorp, it is up to Spider-Man to save the city and his loved ones.

title: The Mermaid
desc: Shan, a mermaid, is sent to assassinate Xuan, a developer who threatens the ecosystem of her race, but ends up falling in love with him instead.

title: Cinderella
desc: After the untimely death of her father, Ella is troubled by her stepmother and stepsisters. However, her life changes forever after dancing with a charming stranger at the Royal Ball.

title: Baby Driver
desc: A gifted getaway driver with hearing impairment works for a ruthless crime boss, seeks freedom with his girlfriend, but is dragged into a dangerous final score.

title: Fall
desc: Two friends stranded atop a remote radio tower face injury, fear, and survival challenges. Their harrowing struggle for rescue tests courage, bond, and human endurance.

title: Seven Swords
desc: A snake demon in Changshou City mutilates living beings. The Descendants of the Seven Swords, adhering to the duty of guarding the peace of the world, fought the snake demon on the Black Devil Cliff.
